newsitem.title: MEXICO: Lucent to invest more than $50 million in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Lucent to invest more than $50 million in Mexico.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc will invest more than $50 million during 1997 to expand one of its plants in Mexico, the company's director for Mexico told reporters.
"The investment for 1997 will be more than $50 million and will be aimed at expanding our plant in Guadalajara," said Rolando Zubiran.
Lucent is a major telecommunications systems providers, and sees double-digit growth in Mexico.
"We are growing the double digits... more than 20 percent. We are now negotiating the sale of private networks with Avantel and we will continue to sell equipment to Telmex," said Zubiran.
